ruleDefinitions.name: AddinUtil.EXE Execution From Uncommon Directory
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the Add-In deployment cache updating utility (AddInutil.exe) from a non-standard directory.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\addinutil\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "AddInUtil\.exe") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\Framework\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\Framework64\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\FrameworkArm\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\FrameworkArm64\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\.*")))
